message.description: Commit message to use; recipes derive one from the changed files when omitted.

title.description: Pull request title; the commit subject when omitted.

body.description: Pull request body, or the reply posted on a pull request.

branch.description: Branch name to create, when the outcome creates one.

pr.description: Pull request number, when the outcome names one.

commit.description: Commit to revert, as a hash or ref.

paths.description: For commit, commit_push, ship_pr, follow_up_pr and amend: name exactly what to commit when the tree has unrelated changes; workspace-relative files or directories.
